definitions.explanation: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or river. Used in geographic, meteorological, and military contexts.

examples.english: There are many towns along the coast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{沿岸|えんがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}している→接近する：25362_sekkinsuru⟧。
examples.english: A typhoon is approaching the coastal area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{沿岸|えんがん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: Fishing has flourished along this coast since ancient times.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a noun modifier: {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧ (coastal area), {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧ (coastal fishing). Refers specifically to the land along a body of water, whereas ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧ focuses more on the beach or shoreline itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: coastal area/region
- {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{漁業|ぎょぎょう}→漁業：20496_gyogyou⟧: coastal fishing
- {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: coastal zone
- {沿岸|えんがん}⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧: coast guard duties
- ⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧{沿岸|えんがん}: Pacific coast
